card.name: Words completing a person or condition phrase
card.fires_on: Words that finish a noun or condition phrase about a person, such as relatives (brother, godson), allergy or sensitivity terms, and asthma-related words. It fires on the word that completes the phrase, often just before a small linking word or punctuation.

modes.label: Allergy and sensitivity terms
modes.description: Words like allergic, sensitive or asthmatic that say a person reacts to something.
modes.example: who is<< allergic>> to egg white, sesame and peanuts.

modes.description: A plural noun ending a phrase about people's possessions or conditions.
modes.example: now have cell<< phones>>. Nearly half of those are smartphones.
